text: Handling deadlines can feel stressful, but it becomes easier with a few simple habits. The first step is time management: break your work into smaller tasks and set mini-deadlines for each one. Next, practice prioritization by listing tasks in order of importance, and focus on the most urgent ones first. Scope management is also crucial—try not to add extra features or details that weren’t originally planned, as this can slow you down. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem coming, tell your manager or teammates early. They may offer help or adjust the deadline. By combining these skills, you can meet deadlines calmly and successfully.
